headline: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault

members.title: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
members.lead: Judge tells disgraced actor and comedian he had displayed ‘casual, arrogant disregard of any woman’s right to say no’ Jemima Goldsmith says ex-partner Russell Brand physically assaulted her Russell Brand was sentenced to more than 10 years in prison on Monday after a judge praised his victims’ bravery and accused him of living “unhindered by the rules by which decent people live”. As the judge, Mr Justice Bennathan, sentenced Brand for raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others, he said he had told the trial “a series of lies”. The disgraced comedian had displayed a “casual, arrogant disregard of any woman’s right to say no”, he said. Continue reading...

members.title: Jemima Goldsmith says ex-partner Russell Brand physically assaulted her
members.lead: TV producer, who was in relationship with ex-comedian that reportedly ended in 2014, accuses him of ‘violence, coercive control and abuse’ Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault Jemima Goldsmith has said Russell Brand physically assaulted her and she accused him of “violence, coercive control and abuse”. The 52-year-old TV producer said she has always been “strongly and unequivocally” on the side of Brand’s victims as she opened up about her own “painful” experience with her former partner in a social media post on Monday.
